name: Mementor Core
author: Norse Digital Group LLC

sections.description:
Mementor Core is a plugin originally built for Mementor’s own clients – but now available to anyone who might find it useful. Instead of writing the same code from scratch for every project, we moved our most common functionality into this plugin. This keeps all our projects up to date and saves us a lot of time when starting something new or updating existing sites.

The features we add are either designed to benefit our clients directly or make it easier for us to maintain websites efficiently. For example, we’ve disabled certain WordPress notification emails, which can be overwhelming when you manage over a hundred sites – especially when other tools are already tracking plugin updates.

We’ve also just launched our Text to Speech (TTS) plugin for WordPress. Feel free to check it out!

Want more features? Try the Text to Speech PRO version here.

Need SEO Tips?

If you’d like to know more about Mementor, visit our website: Mementor.no

All plugin functionality

  • Disable the notification email sent after a plugin is automatically updated.
  • Disable the notification email sent after a theme is automatically updated.
  • Disable the notification email sent after a new user is registered.
  • Disable the notification email sent after a user changes his/her password.
  • Add a custom Mementor dashboard page (its own admin menu item) plus a Mementor dashboard widget. The standard WordPress dashboard is kept intact.
  • Professional Mementor branding throughout the admin area.
  • Custom admin bar with Mementor logo and quick access menu.
  • Real-time display of latest blog posts from mementor.no.
  • “Visste du at?” (Did you know?) section with rotating informational slides.
  • Integrated contact form (for logged-in users) with multiple file attachment support (JPG, PNG, WEBP, AVIF, PDF, DOC, DOCX, XLSX).
  • Customer portal quick access.
  • Maintenance and backup service indicators.
  • Featured services showcase (Text-to-speech, SEO analysis).
  • Popular services grid display (Webdesign, SEO, Digital marketing, Email marketing, AEO, App development).
  • Hide unnecessary WordPress menus for non-administrators (Comments, Themes, Tools, Elementor Templates).
  • User switching functionality for administrators (accessible from Users menu).
  • Responsive design that works on all devices.
  • Modern UI with Mementor’s brand colors (#FF4B4B primary, #f5eee9 background).
  • Secure AJAX operations with nonce verification.
  • Clean uninstall process that removes all plugin data and transients.
sections.faq:
Will this plugin conflict with my theme or any of my plugins?

It shouldn’t. We will test the plugin carefully, and add only code which will work on all of our projects. We have more than a hundred websites with different themes and plugins set up, and will make sure it works on all of them.
sections.changelog:
3.0.1

  • New: Text to Speech (TTSWP) banner on the Mementor dashboard, shown only when the TTS plugin is not installed.
  • Fix: The cache clear button now sends a single valid LiteSpeed purge header, so the server cache is actually purged.
  • Fix: Logging in no longer invalidates the login captcha for other users who are filling in the form at the same time.
  • Change: Users who have been granted the edit_theme_options capability can now access Menus, Widgets, the Customizer and the Appearance menu. Other non-administrators are still restricted as before.
  • Removed unused admin bar CSS that was loaded on every page.

3.0.0

  • Security: Hardened the user-switching feature to prevent unauthorized account access.
  • Security: The contact form can no longer be submitted by logged-out visitors.
  • Security & quality: Resolved all WordPress Plugin Check issues (input sanitization, output escaping, safe redirects, date/random functions).
  • Change: The standard WordPress dashboard is no longer replaced. The Mementor dashboard is now its own menu item, with an added dashboard widget.
  • New: Clickable service cards and updated service links on the Mementor dashboard.
  • Fix: Translations now load correctly from the /languages folder.
  • Updated “Tested up to” to the latest WordPress release.
